    static final int max2N = 1 << maxN;
    static final int maxM = 100;
    static final int maxS = 64184;
    static final int[] sizes = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};
    static long[][] p = new long[maxN][maxM];
    static long[] prev = new long[maxS];
    static long[] cur = new long[maxS];
    static int len;
    static BitSet[] bfs = new BitSet[maxS];
    static BitSet[] what = new BitSet[maxS];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;

    static int bit(int n) {
        return 1 << n;
    }

    static BitSet bitu128(int n) {
        BitSet p = new BitSet(128);
        p.set(n);

    static int findStateIndex(BitSet state) {
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
            pos = (pos * 2 + (state.get(i) ? 1 : 0)) % SZ;

        while (true) {

                bfs[len] = (BitSet) state.clone();
                ind[pos] = len;
                len++;
                return len - 1;

            pos++;
            if (pos == SZ) pos = 0;
        }

    static void initialize(int n) {
        int N = bit(n);
        BitSet[] fixedSize = new BitSet[maxN + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            fixedSize[i] = new BitSet(128);
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {

        len = 0;
        findStateIndex(new BitSet() {{
            set(0);
        }});
        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            BitSet state = bfs[k];
            BitSet[] predHall = new BitSet[maxN];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                nextStates[mask][k] = findStateIndex(nxt);

            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                BitSet fixedSizeMask = new BitSet(128);
                fixedSizeMask.or(fixedSize[i]);
                if (state.intersects(fixedSizeMask)) {

    static long computeMax(int n, int m) {
        Arrays.fill(prev, 0);
        prev[0] = 1;
        int N = bit(n);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {

                    prob = (prob * pProb) % MOD;

        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {

        return answer;
